description:
Recover a task Keelen's own postprocessor re-broke.

    ``escalation_id`` is an open ``platform_policy_conflict`` card that the
    server attributed to Keelen's postprocessor writer. ``decision_md`` is the
    concrete recovery note recorded on the new plan section.

    This is the only customer recovery while the autonomy ladder is enabled.
    It records the decision, requeues the same task lineage and resolves the
    card in one transaction. It raises no scenario or capture budget, issues
    no waiver, consumes no recovery rung and cannot correct a frozen evidence
    selector. A card with any other reason or origin — a ui-review-origin
    conflict, an internal receipt, an exhausted hold, or a budget or catalog
    signal — is refused with a fixed conflict and changes nothing. It is
    registered on `/mcp`, `/chatgpt/mcp` and `/claude/mcp`.
name: resolve_platform_regression
title: Resolve Platform Regression
